name: tree-authored-identity-placeholder-kind-module
body: tree_authored_identity materialises every code-universe placeholder as kind "module" regardless of the target's real Implementation kind, so a per-kind task operation edge to a real Struct/Function target (struct_modify/function_modify/...) is dropped from the tree digest by the pair check while the DB projection keeps it, and is_fresh reads the branch graph as stale. Limit: freshness-gated verify fixtures can only use Module operation edges. Upgrade when a freshness-gated verify fixture needs a non-Module operation edge: derive the placeholder kind from the scanned/planned universe.
